# Third-Party Software

This package includes the OpenDM native DM0.5 runtime, robot constants,
and observation transforms under the Apache License, Version 2.0.
The upstream license and copyright notice are reproduced in `OpenDM.LICENSE`.

The vendored subset excludes unrelated experiment launchers, datasets,
trainers, and optimizers. A nonfunctional development comment was removed.
RoboFATE-specific adaptation is in `robofate/model.py`.
